description.value: Obanhmi is a Vietnamese bánh mì restaurant located in Burnaby's Newton Street area. The name suggests a specialty in the classic Vietnamese baguette sandwich, a popular quick and filling meal for cyclists on the move. The OSM record lists daily hours, indicating consistent availability throughout the week.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a browser security-block page warning of a malicious redirect to cf.miniroad.store — no usable business content was retrieved. All amenity and contact fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM provides address, phone, email, and opening hours but no cyclist-specific amenity data, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null.
concerns: Website (https://www.obanhmishop.com/) appears compromised: the fetched content is entirely a browser security warning blocking a redirect to cf.miniroad.store, a known malicious domain. No actual business content was retrievable. The site may have been hacked or the domain hijacked.
All contact fields (phone, website, address) are unverifiable because no usable website content was returned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: OSM record indicates a real, operating restaurant with address, phone, email, and opening hours; no evidence of closure or phantom listing. Include despite unverifiable amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business's own website should be investigated for compromise before any directory link is published. Consider using only the OSM phone/email as contact information until the website is confirmed safe.
